import JudgeMagma.Magma
import Mathlib.Data.Finite.Defs

@[reducible] def EquationLHS (G : Type _) [Magma G] : Prop := ∀ (x : G) (y : G) (z : G), x = y ◇ (y ◇ (y ◇ (x ◇ (z ◇ y))))
@[reducible] def EquationRHS (G : Type _) [Magma G] : Prop := ∀ (x : G) (y : G), x = y

-- Target type for this verify (verdict-specific, judge-controlled).
abbrev Goal : Prop := ∀ (G : Type) [Magma G] [Finite G], EquationLHS G → EquationRHS G
